flora: Mature Cycads (dense, robust, palm-like fronds, prominent central cones)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile, high-quality textures like tough, leathery fronds and robust trunks; emphasis on the lush, almost tropical feel of a cycad grove; no sharp aggressive angles; overall ancient and verdant feel.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle, sweeping view of a dense grove of mature Cycads, their large fronds forming a thick ground cover, with some prominent central cones visible. The grove extends into a sun-dappled background.
visual_logic.ground: Pale, dusty tan earth with scattered chalky nodules, interspersed with fallen cycad fronds and plant litter.
visual_logic.lighting: High-key direct sunlight creating a warm glow, with dappled light filtering through the fronds, creating interesting shadows and highlights.
